title: Text Scrambler
h1: Text Scrambler — Shuffle Letters Inside Words
seoTitle: Text Scrambler — Free Online Word Letter Mixer
description: Scramble the letters inside each word while keeping the first and last letters in place. Fun for puzzles and reading exercises. Private and instant.
intro: Paste any text. The tool shuffles the middle letters of each word so the text remains surprisingly readable.
blurb: Scramble middle letters of words for puzzles and reading practice.

controls.label: Text to scramble
controls.placeholder: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

howItWorks: Each word longer than three letters has its middle letters randomly reordered.
examples: “The quick brown fox” becomes something like “The qiuck borwn fox”.
Punctuation attached to words is preserved.

faq.q: Why keep the first and last letters?
faq.a: Research shows that words remain readable when only the middle letters are mixed. This makes the result fun rather than unreadable.

faq.q: Is the scramble the same every time?
faq.a: No. Each click produces a new random ordering of the middle letters.
